# Suede Universe Map: full text

> Suede AI builds AI agent platforms businesses use to run their work, and white-labels them for agencies. Founded 2024 by engineer Jason Colapietro.

Source: https://map.suedeai.ai/
Suede AI is an agentic platform company founded in 2024 by engineer Jason Colapietro in West Palm Beach, Florida. It builds and runs AI agent platforms that businesses use to manage their work, and white-labels them for agencies and their clients.

## Entity

Suede AI’s official sites are suedeai.ai, suedeai.org and their subdomains. It was founded in 2024 by Jason Colapietro.

- Organization: https://suedeai.ai/#organization
- Founder: Jason Colapietro, who publishes under the pen name Johnny Suede. https://suedeai.ai/founder#person

Claim boundary: this public operating map documents public pages, links, filings, and stated roles. It does not establish legal title, parent/subsidiary relationships, or ownership percentages.

## The whole Suede universe, on one page

Jason Colapietro builds and operates **more than 30 websites and 9 iOS apps** across a connected public ecosystem. Read this operating map top to bottom to see the people, entities, brand, and shipped surfaces that publicly connect. **Every address is clickable.**

**Claim boundary:** this public operating map documents public pages, links, and stated roles. It does not establish legal title, parent/subsidiary relationships, or ownership percentages.

## Level 1 · The person: Jason Colapietro — engineer, author, and founder of Suede AI

Jason Colapietro is an engineer, author, and the founder and CEO of Suede AI. He has [54 pull requests merged across 46 open-source repositories he does not maintain](https://github.com/search?q=is%3Apr+author%3AJasonColapietro+author%3ASuede-AI+is%3Amerged+-user%3AJasonColapietro+-user%3ASuede-AI&type=pullrequests), including [Jest](https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/16296), [Adobe React Spectrum](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10426), [Backstage](https://github.com/backstage/backstage/pull/35102) and the [Polkadot SDK](https://github.com/paritytech/polkadot-sdk/pull/12853); he has written five books on Amazon in hardcover, paperback, and Kindle, including [The Claude Code Bible](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHTMJWB4) and [Codex in Production](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHTF3LG1); and he has shipped [9 iOS apps under his own Apple developer account](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/jason-colapietro/id1895958699). He publishes under the pen name [Johnny Suede](https://johnnysuede.com).

One founder, two public names. **Jason Colapietro** is the legal name; **Johnny Suede** is the one declared pen name, used for music and the books. His founder page on suedeai.ai is the main record; the Jason and Johnny pages are linked beside it.

- [Founder page](https://suedeai.ai/founder): The main record of who Jason is: his open-source work, books, apps and programs, in one place.
- [Jason Colapietro](https://jasoncolapietro.com): The founder’s page — who Jason is and what he builds.
- [Johnny Suede](https://johnnysuede.com): The artist’s page — original AI-era music and compositions.
- Open source: [54 pull requests merged across 46 external repositories](https://github.com/search?q=is%3Apr+author%3AJasonColapietro+author%3ASuede-AI+is%3Amerged+-user%3AJasonColapietro+-user%3ASuede-AI&type=pullrequests) as of September 2026: 33 code or documentation contributions and 21 accepted listings of his own work. Headline merges: [Jest #16296](https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/16296) and [#16295](https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/16295), [Adobe React Spectrum #10426](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10426) (later replaced by [#10491](https://github.com/adobe/react-spectrum/pull/10491)), [Backstage #35102](https://github.com/backstage/backstage/pull/35102), [Polkadot SDK #12853](https://github.com/paritytech/polkadot-sdk/pull/12853), [Hardhat #8522](https://github.com/NomicFoundation/hardhat/pull/8522), [x402 Foundation #3180](https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/3180) and [zeroclaw #9846](https://github.com/zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw/pull/9846). A Linux kernel USB/IP patch is at public v7 and under review; it is not counted. [Machine-readable record](https://suedeai.ai/open-source-contributions.json).
- Books: Five on Amazon in hardcover, paperback, and Kindle: [The Claude Code Bible](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHTMJWB4), [Codex in Production](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHTF3LG1), [Proof as Infrastructure](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GMB2VLXQ), [Stake Your Claim](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GRG8LGQQ) and [The Human Authenticity Layer](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GD5FX6N6). Plus [The Screenshot](https://seo.suedeai.ai/book) (free on the web) and [The Signal Chain](https://guitar.solutions/).
- Apps: [9 iOS apps on his Apple developer page](https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/jason-colapietro/id1895958699), 6 Android apps and 2 Chrome extensions. The Android editions overlap the iOS apps; every App Store listing is on the shelf further down.
- Programs: Member of [Claude for Startups](https://seo.suedeai.ai/evidence#claude-for-startups), Anthropic’s startup program, since October 8, 2026. Member of [Google Cloud Partner Advantage](https://seo.suedeai.ai/evidence#google-cloud) through JC Investment Group LLC since September 4, 2026. Admitted to [Stripe Startups](https://seo.suedeai.ai/evidence#credentials) in July 2026. Accepted into the Florida Atlantic Entrepreneurship Institute (FAU College of Business) in July 2026, and a member of 1909 in West Palm Beach.

## Level 2 · The company: JC Investment Group LLC

An active Florida limited liability company filed June 3, 2019 (document L19000146068). The public Florida record lists **Jason Colapietro as manager**. Its website and **/domains** directory describe projects and web addresses connected to this operating map.

- [JC Investment Group](https://jcinvestmentgroup.ventures): The company website and its public account of what it backs, builds, and operates.
- [The master domain list](https://jcinvestmentgroup.ventures/domains): A public directory of 19 domain names and destinations. It shows routing, not legal title.

## Level 3 · The brand — three front doors: Suede AI

Suede AI is an agentic platform company founded in 2024 by engineer Jason Colapietro in West Palm Beach, Florida. It builds and runs AI agent platforms that businesses use to manage their work, and white-labels them for agencies and their clients.

Jason Colapietro founded it and leads it: his engineering record, books and apps are in Level 1 above, and his [founder page](https://suedeai.ai/founder) is the main record. Suede AI, also known as Suede Labs, has three main front doors online. They show the same world at different depths, so pick by what you need:

- [The front door](https://suedeai.ai): **Use it when:** you want AI agent platforms for your business, a white-label agent platform for your agency’s clients, or agents Suede builds and runs for you. The company lives here.
- [Research & investors](https://suedeai.org): **Use it when:** you want the research and the investor material. suedeai.org is Suede AI’s research and investor site.
- [The directory](https://hub.suedeai.ai): **Use it when:** you want to browse everything Suede has shipped in one interactive map — every site, app, and endpoint.

## Level 4 · The tools — what you can actually use: Eight shelves of things Suede has shipped

Grouped by what you’d want to do, not by how they’re built. The business tools come first. Music and creator software is a separate Suede product line, further down.

### Run your business on AI agents

Suede AI’s main line of work: agent platforms for your business, white-labelled agent platforms for agencies and their clients, and agents Suede builds and runs for you. **Build in Agent Studio. Track earnings in Agentix. Two different tools.**

- [Suede AI Agent Studio — where you build](https://agents.suedeai.ai): Build agents for the work that repeats, watch every run, and publish an agent as a paid endpoint. No code needed. Start here.
- [White-label agent platforms](https://suedeai.ai/white-label): For agencies: Suede builds and runs an agent platform under your brand, for your clients. Scoped per engagement.
- [Managed AI agents](https://suedeai.ai/managed-ai-agents): Suede builds, runs and tunes AI agents for your business. Every run is visible in Agent Studio.
- [AI operations](https://suedeai.ai/ai-operations): The ongoing side of managed agents: Suede keeps your agents and automated workflows running and tuned, with every run visible in Agent Studio.
- [Forward-deployed engineering](https://suedeai.ai/forward-deployed-engineer): Founder-led: Jason works inside your team to put AI agents into how the company actually works. Also offered as a fractional Chief AI Officer.
- [Suede AI SEO](https://seo.suedeai.ai): Ask ChatGPT for the best tool in your field and it names two or three companies. Suede AI SEO captures what the engines say about you, with dates and screenshots, then repairs the pages they read — a retainer across GEO, PR, reputation and search.
- [Agentix — just the scoreboard](https://agentix.suedeai.ai): Nothing is built here. It only tracks what the agents you launched in Agent Studio are earning, call by call.
- [Suede Signal](https://signal.suedeai.ai): A free AI-readiness audit. Paste your web address and see what ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity can read on your site, what’s missing, and exactly what to fix.
- [Suede Audit](https://optimize.suedeai.ai/): A free check of how ready your public website is for search and AI discovery. You get a score and a prioritized list of repairs.
- [Suede API](https://api.suedeai.xyz): The machine-to-machine doorway. For developers; everyone else can skip it. Also answers at api.suedeai.ai — one service, two addresses, same deployment.

### Jason’s books, posts & code

Five books on Amazon in hardcover, paperback, and Kindle, led by his two engineering guides, plus the writing and code he publishes.

- [The Claude Code Bible](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHTMJWB4): The complete operator’s guide to Claude Code and AI coding agents.
- [Codex in Production](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HHTF3LG1): A practical operator’s guide to OpenAI Codex: AGENTS.md, worktrees, skills, security, and long-running agent work.
- [Stake Your Claim](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GRG8LGQQ): A third Amazon title, on turning the AI onslaught into a real asset.
- [Proof as Infrastructure](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GMB2VLXQ): A fourth, on designing durable systems without trust assumptions.
- [The Human Authenticity Layer](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GD5FX6N6): A fifth, on how ownership, origin, and AI redraw the creative map.
- [The Screenshot](https://seo.suedeai.ai/book): A free book, in full on the web, on why AI recommends your competitors and how to fix it.
- [The newsletter](https://jasoncolapietro.substack.com): Jason’s essays, delivered by email.
- [The blog](https://suedeai.ai/blog): Suede AI’s own writing: original research such as the AI Crawler Access Index, engineering essays, and guides.
- [Claude Code Field Notes](https://claude.suedeai.ai): Six lessons from running AI coding agents in production across 20+ live software surfaces, written up by Jason.
- [AI Suede Podcast](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/): Jason’s podcast feed: conversations and clips on creator ownership, music rights, AI media, and shipping as a solo founder.
- [The code](https://github.com/Suede-AI): Suede’s public source code and docs. Includes brand assets, developer docs, 21 free creator skills, and the SUEDE token repo.
- [Social accounts](https://x.com/AISUEDE): Company account and Jason’s personal account on X — also listed on the Follow Everywhere shelf below.

### On your phone — 9 iOS apps, plus FretPulse

The nine apps on Jason Colapietro’s Apple developer page, plus FretPulse, which is published under its own developer account. All linked straight to their real App Store pages and checked against Apple’s own catalog: most on July 3, 2026, and StoryBeam Kids and GuitarHub on September 19, 2026.

- [Suede AI Agent Studio](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/suede-agent-studio/id6778880737): Build and launch AI agents, right from your phone.
- [Agentix](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/agentix-ai-agent-tracker/id6778286160): Watch the agents you launched earn, call by call.
- [Suede Voice: Vocal Range Test](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/suede-studio-voice/id6767763231): Vocal range, resonance, and pitch analysis with training.
- [AI Music & Video Generator](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/suede-ai-music-generator/id6765461286): Generate original AI music, right from your phone.
- [Suede Guitar Tuner & Studio](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/suede-guitar-tuner-studio/id6767552764): Guitar tools and practice, built for daily playing.
- [FretPulse](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fretpulse-guitar-practice/id6766649729): Auto-generated practice routines and real-time notation.
- [Suede Studio Muse](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/suede-studio-muse/id6779134962): A creative training companion for musicians, from your phone.
- [Suede AI Social](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/suede-social/id6770668793): The iOS app for Suede’s creator community — a separate App Store listing from the suede.social website on the community shelf.
- [GuitarHub: Guitar Lessons](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/guitarhub-guitar-lessons/id6806770875): Guided beginner guitar lessons and practice tools, starting from one note.
- [StoryBeam Kids: Bedtime Books](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/storybeam-kids-bedtime-books/id6785347610): Kids’ podcasts and bedtime storybooks, each one listened to first.

### Music & creator software: create and release

A separate Suede product line for musicians: make music, prepare a finished release, and put it out into the world.

- [Suede AI Studio](https://studio.suedeai.ai): Make music with AI where you own the master and keep 100% of the royalties.
- [Suede AI Distro](https://distro.suedeai.ai): Release finished music through a standalone $7.99/month delivery workflow for 100+ DSPs.
- [Suede Create](https://app.suedeai.ai/create): Create AI music and video in the browser. The app home address now forwards to the proof-of-creation guide; this link opens the creation screen.

### Learn & practice

For guitarists and musicians who want to get better.

- [Strumly](https://strumly.suedeai.ai): A 24/7 AI guitar coach you chat with — it even scores your chord drills.
- [Suede Muse](https://muse.suedeai.ai): A creative training companion for musicians — like a personal trainer for your craft.
- [Suede Play](https://app.suedeai.ai/create): The guided tour of Suede’s musician tools — a good starting point for players.
- [FretPulse](https://fretpulse.suedeai.ai): Guitar care companion — tuner, timing trainer, rig analyzer, gear oracle.

### Agent commerce, tokens & on-chain infrastructure

Agent payments in digital dollars, public token code, agent identity contracts, and developer infrastructure.

- [Suede ACP](https://perform.suedeai.ai/): The business signup desk for agent commerce — set up what you sell so AI agents can buy it, per call, in digital dollars.
- [Suede Promo](https://promo.suedeai.ai): Peer-to-peer marketing for the agentic era — brand grades, creator campaigns, proof-backed payouts.
- [$SUEDE token](https://github.com/Suede-AI/suede-token): The ecosystem’s own token: a LayerZero omnichain token on Solana and Base.
- [Smart contracts & agent identity](https://github.com/Suede-AI): The on-chain contracts and agent-identity system Suede runs on. For developers.
- [Producer & Johnny Suede (AI agents)](https://app.virtuals.io/acp/agent/019e3991-374d-75f3-a6b8-17ff309b4cd2): Two AI agents you can actually hire, live on the Virtuals marketplace.
- [Suede Producer Discovery](https://discovery.suedeai.ai/): Where other AI agents look up Producer: the machine-readable files that list its paid services and how to call them.
- [Suede AI Developer Docs](https://docs.suedeai.ai/): The developer manual for Suede’s pay-per-call (x402) APIs and creator-IP services, with the full docs on GitHub. For developers; everyone else can skip it.

### Community & reading

The guitar-world publications and communities Suede runs.

- [Suede AI Social (the website)](https://suede.social): The creator community and gear magazine in one — takes, rig roasts, profiles. Curated by people, not ranked by an algorithm. Also answers at social.suedeai.ai: one website, two addresses. suede.social is the main one.
- [guitarhub.org — forwards to Suede AI Social](https://guitarhub.org): Not a separate product: this address forwards to the Suede AI Social website above.
- [Suede DNA](https://dna.suedeai.ai): An archive of 400+ famous guitarists’ rigs and signal chains.
- [GuitarChords.info](https://guitarchords.info): Free tools: chord library, scales, tuner, metronome.
- [Guitar.solutions](https://guitar.solutions): Engineering-grade reference for guitar signal chains, pickup to speaker.
- [Guitar Services](https://guitar.services): Jason’s guitar work in one place: two guitar books, a signal chain reference, chord and scale libraries, and AI practice tools.
- [suedeMarket](https://market.suedeai.ai/): A marketplace to buy and sell musical instruments, built for both people and AI agents.
- [Suede NFT Studio](https://nft.suedeai.ai): Solana NFT tools: collections, metadata, and rights tracking for on-chain drops.
- [Suede Cosmos](https://cosmos.suedeai.ai): A navigable galaxy of music — stars cluster by genre and brighten by relevance, click any to explore.

## Questions this map exists to answer

### What is Suede AI?

Suede AI is an agentic platform company founded in 2024 by engineer Jason Colapietro in West Palm Beach, Florida. It builds and runs AI agent platforms that businesses use to manage their work, and white-labels them for agencies and their clients.

### What is the Suede Universe Map?

A plain-English wayfinding page for everything Suede AI and JC Investment Group run in public: the person, the registered company, the three front doors, the shipped tools, and the listed domains. It maps what exists and where to click. It is not a cap table or a record of legal ownership.

### Is Agentix the same as Suede AI Agent Studio?

No, and it is the most common mix-up. agents.suedeai.ai is Suede AI Agent Studio, where you build agents. agentix.suedeai.ai is the earnings tracker that shows what those agents have made. Different addresses, different jobs.

### Which address is the canonical Suede API?

api.suedeai.xyz is canonical. The address api.suedeai.ai answers identically but is not canonical, and there is deliberately no redirect between the two, because redirecting a live pay-per-call gateway would break agent clients mid-payment.

### Are suede.social and social.suedeai.ai different sites?

No. They are two addresses for one website, and suede.social is the main address. There is also a separate Suede Social app in the iOS App Store. Two doors, one place.

### What does a green dot next to an address mean?

That the address answered a live request when this map was last checked, on the date stamped at the bottom of this page. Third-party addresses such as Substack or Amazon carry no dot, because this map makes no liveness claim about them.

## Press kit

Source: https://map.suedeai.ai/press/

### Everything a journalist needs, copy-ready.

Boilerplate, facts, founder bio, approved quotes, story angles, logos, and b-roll for **Suede AI**, the agentic platform company founded by engineer Jason Colapietro. Live-surface metrics were checked July 3, 2026; entity filing checked July 15, 2026; the boilerplate, founder bio and fact sheet were updated October 19, 2026. ### Boilerplate

Suede AI is an agentic platform company founded in 2024 by engineer Jason Colapietro in West Palm Beach, Florida. It builds and runs AI agent platforms that businesses use to manage their work, and white-labels them for agencies and their clients.

Suede AI is an agentic platform company founded in 2024 by engineer Jason Colapietro in West Palm Beach, Florida. It builds and runs AI agent platforms that businesses use to manage their work, and white-labels them for agencies and their clients. In Suede AI Agent Studio, a business builds agents for the work that repeats, watches every run, and can publish an agent as a paid endpoint. For agencies, Suede builds and runs an agent platform under the agency’s brand for its clients. Suede also builds, runs and tunes managed agents for businesses, offers founder-led forward-deployed engineering, and runs Suede AI SEO, its AI search visibility practice. Music and creator software is a separate product line. Jason Colapietro has 54 pull requests merged across 46 open-source repositories he does not maintain, five books on Amazon in hardcover, paperback, and Kindle and 9 iOS apps. The whole estate, more than 30 live sites, is mapped and live-checked at map.suedeai.ai.

**Claim boundary:** this public operating map documents public pages, links, and stated roles. It does not establish legal title, parent/subsidiary relationships, or ownership percentages.

### How Suede works

Build In Suede AI Agent Studio, a business builds agents for the work that repeats, watches every run, and can publish an agent as a paid endpoint.

White-label For agencies, Suede builds and runs an agent platform under the agency’s brand, for its clients. Scoped per engagement.

Run Suede builds, runs and tunes agents for a business, with every run visible in Agent Studio.

### Founder bio

Jason Colapietro is an engineer, author, and the founder and CEO of Suede AI. He has 54 pull requests merged across 46 open-source repositories he does not maintain, including Jest, Adobe React Spectrum, Backstage and the Polkadot SDK; he has written five books on Amazon in hardcover, paperback, and Kindle, including The Claude Code Bible and Codex in Production; and he has shipped 9 iOS apps under his own Apple developer account. He publishes under the pen name Johnny Suede. Before Suede, he built, ran, and sold call centers. The Florida public filing for JC Investment Group LLC lists him as manager.

Approved founder photos ship with the brand asset pack: [github.com/Suede-AI/suede-brand-assets](https://github.com/Suede-AI/suede-brand-assets). For a specific format or resolution, email info@suedeai.ai.

### Guest bio & how to credit

Built for third parties: podcast show notes, conference programmes, panel bios, bylines. Every version leads with the legal name, discloses the pen name, and ends with the canonical founder URL. Plain text, no formatting, paste as-is. If you use only one line, use the credit line.

### Story angles

- **The founder's code is in Jest and Backstage.** Before building agent platforms, Jason Colapietro had pull requests merged into Jest, Adobe React Spectrum, Backstage and the Polkadot SDK: 54 merged across 46 open-source repositories he does not maintain, with the full record public on GitHub.
- **Agent platforms, white-labelled.** Agencies want to offer AI agents to their clients without building a platform. Suede builds and runs one under the agency's brand, scoped per engagement.
- **Agents are already paying.** Autonomous AI agents settle per-call USDC payments on Base mainnet for music and IP services. Machine-to-machine commerce, live, with published prices from $0.15 per call.
- **One founder, thirty live surfaces.** A solo founder operates an ecosystem most companies would staff a team for: apps, endpoints, communities, publications, all shipped and publicly verifiable.
- **Verified, not vaporware.** The entire ecosystem is publicly mapped, with every address live-checked and the audit published at map.suedeai.ai.
